title: 'VPNs are lawful technical tools,' says EU Court in landmark copyright ruling
summary: The EU Court of Justice has ruled that VPNs are lawful technical tools in a landmark copyright case involving the Anne Frank diary, determining that VPN providers cannot be held liable for users who employ their services to access pirated content.
problem_solved: Clarifies the legal status of VPN technology in the EU, protecting both VPN providers and users from copyright infringement liability.
why_valuable: Provides crucial legal precedent that shields VPN services from being banned or restricted due to potential misuse, safeguarding internet privacy and freedom in Europe.
